headline: A 2022 law renamed the Owasso, Oklahoma, Postal Service building after Technical Sergeant Marshal Roberts.
what_it_does: The law officially names the United States Postal Service facility at 1233 North Cedar Street in Owasso, Oklahoma, the Technical Sergeant Marshal Roberts Post Office Building. It changes only the building's official name and does not change postal services, rules, or staffing. The name honors Marshal Roberts, a technical sergeant.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 16, 2022.
